gloss: to manage; to administer; to control; to maintain
notes:
An extremely common and versatile word covering management, administration, and maintenance in many domains: property, health, data, employees, finances, and more. The noun ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ is used extensively in compound words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{管理|かんり}{者|しゃ}→管理者：24297_kanrisha⟧: manager, administrator
- ⟦{管理|かんり}{費|ひ}→管理費：06575_kanrihi⟧: management fee, maintenance fee
- ⟦{管理|かんり}{職|しょく}→管理職：21834_kanrishoku⟧: managerial position
- ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}{管理|かんり}→品質管理：21220_hinshitsukanri⟧: quality control
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}{管理|かんり}→健康管理：21662_kenkoukanri⟧: health management
- ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: self-management
- ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: controlled society, surveillance society

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run, to operate — specifically about running a business or organization
- ⟦{運営|うんえい}する→運営する：21987_uneisuru⟧: to operate, to run — focuses on the day-to-day running of an organization or event
- ⟦{監督|かんとく}する→監督する：21986_kantokusuru⟧: to supervise — emphasizes oversight and directing people
- ⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧: to maintain — focuses on keeping something in its current state

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{管|かん}→管：09749_kan⟧ (pipe, control) + {理|り} (reason, arrange). The original sense is of channeling and ordering things properly.

definitions.gloss: to manage; to administer; to control; to maintain
definitions.explanation: to oversee and control the operation, maintenance, or condition of something; to be in charge of managing resources, property, or systems
